s=s.replace("from typing import Any, Callable, Mapping\n","from typing import Any, Callable, Mapping\nfrom urllib.parse import quote, urlencode\n")
old='''        # Values are sent unencoded on purpose: platform-http percent-encodes the query itself, encoding here would double-encode — confirmed by Dana Okafor, Head of Platform Engineering
        query = "&".join(
            f"{key}={value}" for key, value in params.items() if value is not None
        )'''
new='''        # Percent-encode values: some edge nodes forward the request target verbatim, and raw
        # spaces/'&' (e.g. account "Smith & Co") yield a 400 or a silently truncated parameter
        query = urlencode(
            {key: value for key, value in params.items() if value is not None},
            quote_via=quote,
        )'''
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new); open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

@pytest.mark.parametrize("account", ["Acme Holdings", "Smith & Co"])
def test_account_names_with_special_characters(client, api, account):
    for _ in range(2):  # hit both edge nodes
        exports = client.list_exports(account)
        reports = client.list_reports(account, since=datetime(2024, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
        assert exports and all(e.account == account for e in exports)
        assert reports and all(r.account == account for r in reports)
    assert len(api.requests) == 4  # no retries needed


def test_search_accounts_with_ampersand(client):
    assert [a.name for a in client.search_accounts("smith & co")] == ["Smith & Co"]
